annotations.title: List or transcribe a YouTube playlist

description: List a YouTube playlist's videos, or list and transcribe all of them, as one asynchronous job. Use when the user gives a playlist link or id and wants its videos or their transcripts — e.g. "summarize every video in this playlist". mode="list" (default) collects video metadata only, free beyond the listing credit; mode="transcribe" also transcribes each listed video, billed per delivered transcript variant with the same first-delivery-free rule as transcriptlab_get_transcript. Transcription is capped at 250 videos per job; with multiple playlists the effective per-playlist limit is reduced to fit that total. Returns a job id: poll transcriptlab_get_job_status, then read per-video results with transcriptlab_list_job_items.

lang.description: Caption language for mode=transcribe. Omit it to get each video's own language.

max_videos.description: How many newest videos to list per playlist; defaults to 100. Plan limits apply. In transcribe mode the effective per-playlist limit is reduced when multiple playlists would exceed 250 videos total.

mode.description: list (default) collects metadata only; transcribe also fetches a transcript for each video.

playlist.description: One or more playlist URLs (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=..., or any YouTube URL carrying ?list=) or bare playlist ids.

translate.description: Translate captions to this language when available (mode=transcribe only).

type.description: Caption track type for mode=transcribe; defaults to any.
